body.x: [Pipeline Position] Participant and Course Operations Associate (Africa Regional Office) [Based in Kigali]
***This is a pipeline position created to prepare for anticipated hiring needs. Final hiring decisions will be made following internal review processes.***

We are seeking a Participant and Course Operations Associate for a 2-year-regular position (renewable) to work within Africa Regional Office at the International Vaccine Institute in Kigali, Rwanda. (Duty Station: Kigali, Rwanda)

This role is responsible for the practical operation of VEA4A courses and participant support from recruitment through close-out. It encompasses participant communication, course preparation and on-site support, LMS enrolment and access support, and the maintenance of participant and course records across participating institutions.
Coordinate participant calls, application processes, screening, selection documentation, offers, waitlists and communication with applicants.
Coordinate onboarding, consent, baseline information, accessibility assessment, safeguarding orientation and participant-support requirements.
Manage LMS enrolment, participant communications, reminders and access support.
Prepare detailed course schedules, trainer rosters, room and session plans, run sheets, readiness checklists and materials lists.
Coordinate participant and course requirements with HEIs, trainers, providers, the Academic, Curriculum and Faculty Coordination Associate and the Project Administrator.
Manage programme-side on-site course operations and track daily delivery issues to resolution.
Coordinate accommodation, transport, accessibility, childcare and other participant-support requirements, while the Project Administrator manages procurement, contracting and payments.
Maintain standard course-operation tools and improve them based on delivery experience.
Maintain reconciled participant, attendance, assessment, completion, certification and feedback records.
Coordinate assessment close-out, certificates, participant feedback and outstanding actions after each course.
Support participant-data workflows, digital-platform testing and routine MEL data collection under approved data and privacy procedures.
Bachelor’s Degree in programme administration, education, public health, social sciences, information management, business or a related field.
Experience in participant administration, course operations, training logistics, learning systems or educational programme delivery.
Experience maintaining participant, attendance, assessment and certification records.
Ability to coordinate high-volume workflows across several institutions and delivery sites.
Experience with LMS platforms, databases, digital forms or participant-management systems is desirable.
Demonstrated sensitivity to safeguarding, accessibility, inclusion and data privacy.
Ability to work flexibly across institutions and workstreams.
Fluent in English (spoken, written), French is desirable
***IVI welcomes applications from all sections of the community. We encourage women to apply, especially from countries that are currently under-represented within IVI.***
